---
title: "Gallery Usage"
---

This page summarizes how readers are finding and using the Gallery. Counts are
aggregated by Cloudflare Web Analytics and refreshed automatically several times
each day.

```{=html}
<div class="gallery-usage" data-gallery-usage
     data-endpoint="https://gallery-analytics.gallery-analytics-worker.workers.dev/v1/summary">
<p class="gallery-usage__status" data-usage-status role="status" aria-live="polite">
Loading the current usage summary...
</p>

<div data-usage-content hidden>
<div class="gallery-usage__metrics" aria-label="Gallery usage totals">
<dl class="gallery-usage__metric">
<dt>Visits, last 7 days</dt>
<dd data-metric="visits-7">0</dd>
</dl>
<dl class="gallery-usage__metric">
<dt>Page views, last 7 days</dt>
<dd data-metric="pageviews-7">0</dd>
</dl>
<dl class="gallery-usage__metric">
<dt>Visits, last 30 days</dt>
<dd data-metric="visits-30">0</dd>
</dl>
<dl class="gallery-usage__metric">
<dt>Page views, last 30 days</dt>
<dd data-metric="pageviews-30">0</dd>
</dl>
</div>

<h2>Most visited pages</h2>
<div class="gallery-scroll-table gallery-usage__table">
<table>
<thead><tr><th scope="col">Gallery page</th><th scope="col">Page views</th></tr></thead>
<tbody data-table="pages"></tbody>
</table>
</div>

<div class="gallery-usage__columns">
<section>
<h2>Visitor countries</h2>
<div class="gallery-usage__table">
<table>
<thead><tr><th scope="col">Country</th><th scope="col">Visits</th></tr></thead>
<tbody data-table="countries"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
<section>
<h2>Referring sites</h2>
<div class="gallery-usage__table">
<table>
<thead><tr><th scope="col">Referrer</th><th scope="col">Visits</th></tr></thead>
<tbody data-table="referrers"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</section>
</div>

<p class="gallery-usage__sampling" data-usage-sampling hidden>
Cloudflare applied adaptive sampling to at least one displayed aggregate; the
reported counts are sampling-adjusted estimates.
</p>
</div>

<noscript>
<p class="gallery-usage__status gallery-usage__status--unavailable">
The current usage summary requires JavaScript. All examples and reference
```

## How to interpret the counts

A **page view** records a successfully loaded Gallery page. A **visit** begins
when a page view arrives from another website or a direct link; one visit may
therefore include several page views. These are not labelled as unique visitors.

Tracking began on November 21, 2026. Until 30 days have elapsed, the rolling
totals cover only the shorter period since tracking began.

Cloudflare Web Analytics is browser-based, so the figures can omit readers who
block JavaScript or analytics requests. Recognized bots are excluded. Countries
and referring sites with fewer than five visits are not displayed, and the
public summary contains no raw IP addresses, query strings, or individual visit
records.
